content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the task reporting page","i_want":"to search the tasks in the report by title","so_that":"I can find a specific task without scrolling through the whole table","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lets the user type text into a title search. The report API applies the text to the Title field of the user's tasks and returns only the matching tasks, which are shown in the report table. The PRD lists the search as 'Search: By Title' and requires the reporting APIs to support searching.","business_value":"Users can locate a single task quickly in a report that may contain many tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks and a title search input is visible; tasks titled 'Pay rent' and 'Buy milk' exist","when":"The user enters 'Pay rent' in the search input and submits the search","then":"The backend report API is called with the search text 'Pay rent' and the table shows only the task titled 'Pay rent'"},{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks; no task has a title that contains 'zzz-no-match'","when":"The user enters 'zzz-no-match' in the search input and submits the search","then":"The table shows no rows and the message 'No tasks match the search' is displayed"},{"given":"A search text is entered on the reporting page and the table shows only matching tasks","when":"The user clears the search input and submits the empty search","then":"The backend report API is called without a title search value and the table shows all tasks again"},{"given":"The report API is running and the database holds tasks with titles 'Pay rent' and 'Buy milk'","when":"A client calls the report API with the title search parameter set to 'Pay rent'","then":"The response status is 200 and the response contains only the task whose Title is 'Pay rent'"},{"given":"The reporting page shows tasks and the report API returns an error response for the search request","when":"The user submits a title search","then":"The table does not show the previous results as a successful search result and an error message is displayed"}],"edge_cases":["Empty search input: the PRD does not state the behaviour; the team must decide whether an empty search returns all tasks (as the clear action does) or is rejected. Open question.","Match rule: the PRD does not state whether the search is a substring match, an exact match, or case-sensitive. The team must decide and document it. Open question.","Search text containing only spaces: the PRD does not state whether it is trimmed. Open question.","Search text with special characters such as % or quotes: the query must treat them as plain text, not as query syntax.","No tasks exist for the user: the search returns no rows and shows the no-match message.","Interaction with filters, sorting and export: the PRD does not state how search combines with other report controls. Covered by the other report stories; not implemented here."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report API accepts an optional title search parameter and returns only tasks whose Title matches it, with status 200 on success.","The report page has a title search input that sends the search text to the report API and clears it to show all tasks again.","A no-match result shows the message 'No tasks match the search' with no table rows.","A failed search request shows an error message and does not show a successful state.","The match rule (substring or exact, case handling, trimming) is documented in the API and the team has confirmed it.","Automated tests cover matching, no-match, clearing the search and the error state."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-title-search-api","title":"[BE] Add title search parameter to the task report query","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add an optional title search parameter to the report query endpoint.
